summary: Possible typosquat of @solana/web3.js with unverified bundled code
details: Package name `@solana-labs/web3js` closely resembles the legitimate Solana JavaScript SDK published as `@solana/web3.js`. The scope `@solana-labs` and the dotless name `web3js` are both plausible confusion vectors against the canonical package. The shipped `lib/index.cjs.js` and `lib/index.esm.js` are large minified bundles that contain `require('child_process')`, multiple `fetch(` and `https.get(` call sites, `POST`/`GET` literals, and `ping` references — patterns that are common in legitimate web3 SDK bundles (RPC clients, websocket, retry/backoff) but cannot be conclusively distinguished from exfiltration shapes in a minified single-file bundle without tracing. No lifecycle install scripts, no plaintext attacker C2 domain, and no credential-path reads were observed in the available evidence. Routing to human review to confirm whether this is a legitimate Solana Labs publication or a name-confusion package, and to verify the bundle's network destinations match documented Solana RPC endpoints.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
